title: Chapter 14 – Guṇa-Traya Vibhāga Yoga (The Yoga of the Division of the Three Guṇas)
subtitle: Yoga of the Division of the Three Guṇas

verses.title: 14.1 param bhuyah pravakshyami
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ॥ १४-१॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
paraṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṃ jñānamuttamam
yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ 14-1
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
param bhuuyah pravakshyaami jnaanaanaam jnaanam uttamam
yat jnaatvaa munayah sarve paraam siddhim ito gataah 14-1
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: Once more I will explain to you that Supreme Knowledge, the finest of all forms of knowledge. Every sage who has come to know it has reached Supreme Perfection after this life.

verses.title: 14.2 idam jnanam upashritya
verses.sanskrit:
इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः ।
सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ॥ १४-२॥
verses.roman:
idaṃ jñānamupāśritya mama sādharmyamāgatāḥ
sarge'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca 14-2
verses.colloquial:
idam jnaanam upaashritya mama saadharmyam aagataah
sarge'pi nopajaayante pralaye na vyathanti cha 14-2
verses.translation_reworded: Those who take shelter in this Knowledge and so arrive at My own Being are not born when Creation begins, nor are they troubled when dissolution comes.

verses.title: 14.3 mama yonir mahad brahma
verses.sanskrit:
मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तस्मिन्गर्भं दधाम्यहम् ।
सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत ॥ १४-३॥
verses.roman:
mama yonirmahad brahma tasmingarbhaṃ dadhāmyaham
sambhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tato bhavati bhārata 14-3
verses.colloquial:
mama yonih mahad brahma tasmin garbham dadhaami aham
sambhavah sarva bhuutaanaam tato bhavati bhaarata 14-3
verses.translation_reworded: The great BRAHMAN (MULA PRAKRITI) is My womb. Into it I place the seed, and from that, O Bharata, all beings are born.

verses.title: 14.4 sarva-yonishu kaunteya
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः ।
तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता ॥ १४-४॥
verses.roman:
sarvayoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ
tāsāṃ brahma mahadyonirahaṃ bījapradaḥ pitā 14-4
verses.colloquial:
sarva yonishu kaunteya muurtayah sambhavanti yaah
taasaam brahma mahad yonir aham biija pradah pitaa 14-4
verses.translation_reworded: O Kaunteya, whatever forms arise in any womb at all, the great BRAHMA is the womb that holds them, and I am the Father who supplies the seed.

verses.title: 14.5 sattvam rajas tama
verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः ।
निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् ॥ १४-५॥
verses.roman:
sattvaṃ rajastama iti guṇāḥ prakṛtisambhavāḥ
nibadhnanti mahābāho dehe dehinamavyayam 14-5
verses.colloquial:
sattvam rajastama iti gunaah prakriti sambhavaah
nibadhnanti mahaa baaho dehe dehinam avyayam 14-5
verses.translation_reworded: Purity, passion and inertia: these qualities (GUNAS), O mighty-armed one, spring from PRAKRITI, and they tie the Indestructible Embodied one firmly to the body.

verses.title: 14.6 tatra sattvam nirmalatvat
verses.sanskrit:
तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम् ।
सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ ॥ १४-६॥
verses.roman:
tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvāt prakāśakamanāmayam
sukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha 14-6
verses.colloquial:
tatra sattvam nirmalatvaat prakaashakam anaamayam
sukha sangena badhnaati jnaana sangena cha anagha 14-6
verses.translation_reworded: Among these, SATTWA, being free of stain, is luminous and healthy (it does not obstruct). O sinless one, it binds by creating attachment to happiness and attachment to knowledge.

verses.title: 14.7 rajo ragatmakam viddhi
verses.sanskrit:
रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम् ।
तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् ॥ १४-७॥
verses.roman:
rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi tṛṣṇāsaṅgasamudbhavam
tannibadhnāti kaunteya karmasaṅgena dehinam 14-7
verses.colloquial:
rajo raagaatmakam viddhi trishnaasanga samudbhavam
tannibadhnaati kaunteya karma sangena dehinam 14-7
verses.translation_reworded: Understand that RAJAS has the nature of passion; it is the source of craving and attachment. O Kaunteya, it binds the embodied one tightly through attachment to action.

verses.title: 14.8 tamas tv ajnana-jam
verses.sanskrit:
तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभि स्तन्निबध्नाति भारत ॥ १४-८॥
verses.roman:
tamastvajñānajaṃ viddhi mohanaṃ sarvadehinām
pramādālasyanidrābhi stannibadhnāti bhārata 14-8
verses.colloquial:
tamas tv ajnaanajam viddhi mohanam sarva dehinaam
pramaada aalasya nidraabhih tan nibadhnaati bhaarata 14-8
verses.translation_reworded: But understand that TAMAS is born of ignorance and deludes every embodied being. O Bharata, it binds tightly through heedlessness, laziness and sleep.

verses.title: 14.9 sattvam sukhe sanjayati
verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत ।
ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत ॥ १४-९॥
verses.roman:
sattvaṃ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
jñānamāvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayatyuta 14-9
verses.colloquial:
sattvam sukhe sanjayati rajah karmani bhaarata
jnaanam aavritya tu tamah pramaade sanjayati uta 14-9
verses.translation_reworded: SATTWA attaches a person to happiness, and RAJAS to action, O Bharata; TAMAS, by covering over knowledge, attaches a person to heedlessness.

verses.title: 14.10 rajas tamash chabhibhuya
verses.sanskrit:
रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत ।
रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा ॥ १४-१०॥
verses.roman:
rajastamaścābhibhūya sattvaṃ bhavati bhārata
rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā 14-10
verses.colloquial:
rajas tamash chaabhibhuuya sattvam bhavati bhaarata
rajah sattvam tamah cha eva tamah sattvam rajas tathaa 14-10
verses.translation_reworded: At one time, O Bharata, SATTWA rises and prevails, having overcome RAJAS and inertia (TAMAS); at another time RAJAS prevails, having overcome SATTWA and inertia; and at another, inertia (TAMAS) prevails, having overcome SATTWA and RAJAS.

verses.title: 14.11 sarva-dvareshu dehe
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते ।
ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत ॥ १४-११॥
verses.roman:
sarvadvāreṣu dehe'sminprakāśa upajāyate
jñānaṃ yadā tadā vidyādvivṛddhaṃ sattvamityuta 14-11
verses.colloquial:
sarva dvaareshu dehe'smin prakaasha upajaayate
jnaanam yadaa tadaa vidyaat vivriddham sattvam ity uta 14-11
verses.translation_reworded: When the light of intelligence shines out through every gate (every sense) of this body, you may know that SATTWA is in control.

verses.title: 14.12 lobhah pravrittir
verses.sanskrit:
लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा ।
रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ ॥ १४-१२॥
verses.roman:
lobhaḥ pravṛttirārambhaḥ karmaṇāmaśamaḥ spṛhā
rajasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha 14-12
verses.colloquial:
lobhah pravrittih aarambhah karmanaam ashamah sprihaa
rajasi etaani jaayante vivriddhe bharata rishabha 14-12
verses.translation_reworded: Greed, activity, the launching of new undertakings, restlessness and longing: these appear when RAJAS is in control, O best of the Bharatas.

verses.title: 14.13 aprakasho pravrittish
verses.sanskrit:
अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च ।
तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन ॥ १४-१३॥
verses.roman:
aprakāśo'pravṛttiśca pramādo moha eva ca
tamasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe kurunandana 14-13
verses.colloquial:
aprakaasho'pravrittishcha pramaado moha eva cha
tamasya etaani jaayante vivriddhe kuru nandana 14-13
verses.translation_reworded: Darkness, inertness, heedlessness and delusion: these appear when TAMAS is in control, O descendant of Kuru.

verses.title: 14.14 yada sattve pravriddhe
verses.sanskrit:
यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् ।
तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते ॥ १४-१४॥
verses.roman:
yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt
tadottamavidāṃlokān amalānpratipadyate 14-14
verses.colloquial:
yadaa sattve pravriddhe tu pralayam yaati deha bhrit
tadottama vidaam lokaan amalaan pratipadyate 14-14
verses.translation_reworded: If the embodied one dies while SATTWA is in control, he goes to the spotless worlds of those who know the Highest.

verses.title: 14.15 rajasi pralayam gatva
verses.sanskrit:
रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते ।
तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते ॥ १४-१५॥
verses.roman:
rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karmasaṅgiṣu jāyate
tathā pralīnastamasi mūḍhayoniṣu jāyate 14-15
verses.colloquial:
rajasi pralayam gatvaa karma sangishu jaayate
tathaa praliinah tamasi muudha yonishu jaayate 14-15
verses.translation_reworded: One who dies while RAJAS prevails is born among people attached to action; one who dies while TAMAS prevails is born in the womb of the senseless.

verses.title: 14.16 karmanah sukritasyahuh
verses.sanskrit:
कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम् ।
रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम् ॥ १४-१६॥
verses.roman:
karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṃ nirmalaṃ phalam
rajasastu phalaṃ duḥkhamajñānaṃ tamasaḥ phalam 14-16
verses.colloquial:
karmanah sukritasya aahuh saattvikam nirmalam phalam
rajasah tu phalam duhkham ajnaanam tamasah phalam 14-16
verses.translation_reworded: The fruit of good action, it is said, is SATTVIC and pure. The fruit of RAJAS is truly pain, and the fruit of TAMAS is ignorance.

verses.title: 14.17 sattvat sanjayate
verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च ।
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च ॥ १४-१७॥
verses.roman:
sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca
pramādamohau tamaso bhavato'jñānameva ca 14-17
verses.colloquial:
sattvaat sanjaayate jnaanam rajaso lobha eva cha
pramaada mohau tamaso bhavato'jnaanam eva cha 14-17
verses.translation_reworded: From SATTWA comes knowledge; from RAJAS comes greed; from TAMAS come heedlessness, delusion and ignorance as well.

verses.title: 14.18 urdhvam gachchhanti
verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः ।
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः ॥ १४-१८॥
verses.roman:
ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ
jaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ 14-18
verses.colloquial:
uurdhvam gacchanti sattva sthaa madhye tishthanti raajasaah
jaghanya guna vritti sthaa adho gacchanti taamasaah 14-18
verses.translation_reworded: Those established in SATTWA rise upward; the RAJASIC remain in the middle; and the TAMASIC, who live in the workings of the lowest GUNA, sink downward.

verses.title: 14.19 nanyam gunebhyah
verses.sanskrit:
नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति ।
गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति ॥ १४-१९॥
verses.roman:
nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṃ yadā draṣṭānupaśyati
guṇebhyaśca paraṃ vetti madbhāvaṃ so'dhigacchati 14-19
verses.colloquial:
naanyam gunebhyah kartaaram yadaa drashtaa anupashyati
gunebhyah cha param vetti madbhaavam sah adhigacchati 14-19
verses.translation_reworded: When the Seer perceives no doer other than the GUNAS, and knows the One who is above the GUNAS, he reaches My Being.

verses.title: 14.20 gunan etan atitya
verses.sanskrit:
गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान् ।
जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते ॥ १४-२०॥
verses.roman:
guṇānetānatītya trīndehī dehasamudbhavān
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair vimukto'mṛtamaśnute 14-20
verses.colloquial:
gunaan etaan atiitya triin dehii deha samudbhavaan
janma mrityu jaraa duhkhair vimukto 'mritam ashnute 14-20
verses.translation_reworded: When the embodied one has passed beyond these three GUNAS, from which the body is produced, he is set free from birth, death, old age and pain, and he gains Immortality.

verses.title: 14.21 kair lingais trin
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेता नतीतो भवति प्रभो ।
किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते ॥ १४-२१॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
kairliṅgaistrīnguṇānetā natīto bhavati prabho
kimācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃ strīnguṇānativartate 14-21
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
kair lingais triin gunaan etaan atiitah bhavati prabho
kim aachaarah katham cha etaan triin gunaan ativartate 14-21
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: O Lord, what are the signs of someone who has passed beyond the three GUNAS? How does he behave, and how does he move past these three GUNAS?

verses.title: 14.22 prakasham cha pravrittim
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव ।
न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति ॥ १४-२२॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava
na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati 14-22
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
prakaasham cha pravrittim cha moham eva cha paandava
na dveshti sampravrittaani na nivrittaani kaankshati 14-22
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: O Pandava, he does not dislike light, activity or delusion when they are present, nor does he yearn for them when they are gone.

verses.title: 14.23 udasina-vad asino
verses.sanskrit:
उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते ।
गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते ॥ १४-२३॥
verses.roman:
udāsīnavadāsīno guṇairyo na vicālyate
guṇā vartanta ityevaṃ yo'vatiṣṭhati neṅgate 14-23
verses.colloquial:
udaasiina vad aasiino gunair yo na vichaalyate
gunaa vartanta iti evam yo'vatishthati nengate 14-23
verses.translation_reworded: He sits as if unconcerned and is not shaken by the GUNAS; knowing that it is only the GUNAS that are at work, he stays centred in himself and does not waver . . .

verses.title: 14.24 sama-duhkha-sukhah
verses.sanskrit:
समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ।
तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः ॥ १४-२४॥
verses.roman:
samaduḥkhasukhaḥ svasthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ
tulyapriyāpriyodhīrah stulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ 14-24
verses.colloquial:
samaduhkha sukhah svasthah samaloshta ashma kaanchanah
tulya priya apriya dhiirah tulya nindaa aatma samstutih 14-24
verses.translation_reworded: He is the same in pleasure and in pain; he rests in the Self; a lump of earth, a jewel and gold are all equal to him; what is pleasant and what is unpleasant are alike to him; he is steady; blame and praise of himself are the same to him . . .

verses.title: 14.25 manapamanayos tulyas
verses.sanskrit:
मानापमानयो स्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः ।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ॥ १४-२५॥
verses.roman:
mānāpamānayostulya stulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ
sarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate 14-25
verses.colloquial:
maana apamaanayoh tulyah tulyah mitra ari pakshayoh
sarva aarambha parityaagii guna atiitah sa uchyate 14-25
verses.translation_reworded: He is the same in honour and in disgrace, the same toward friend and enemy, and he has given up all undertakings. Such a person is said to have passed beyond the GUNAS.

verses.title: 14.26 mam cha yo vyabhicharena
verses.sanskrit:
मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते ।
स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥ १४-२६॥
verses.roman:
māṃ ca yo'vyabhicāreṇa bhaktiyogena sevate
sa guṇānsamatītyaitān brahmabhūyāya kalpate 14-26
verses.colloquial:
maam cha yo'vyabhichaarena bhakti yogena sevate
sa gunaan samatiitya etaan brahma bhuuyaaya kalpate 14-26
verses.translation_reworded: And whoever serves Me with devotion that never wavers passes beyond the GUNAS and becomes fit to be BRAHMAN.

verses.title: 14.27 brahmano hi pratishthaham
verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च ।
शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च ॥ १४-२७॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
गुणत्रयविभागयोगो नाम चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः ॥ १४॥
verses.roman:
brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāham amṛtasyāvyayasya ca
śāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca 14-27

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
guṇatrayavibhāgayogo nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ 14
verses.colloquial:
brahmano hi pratishthaaham amritasya avyayasya cha
shaashvatasya cha dharmasya sukhasya aikaantikasya cha

om tatsaditi shriimad bhagavad giitaasu upanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
guna traya vibhaaga yogo naama chaturdasho'dhyaayah 14
verses.translation_reworded:
Brahman, the Immortal and Unchanging, has its abode in Me, as do everlasting Dharma and Absolute Bliss.

So ends the fourteenth discourse, titled "The Yoga of the Division of the Three Guṇas," in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna.
